This test takes an input file
and has a derivation that:

- Writes its $in file twice to $out.
- Does not depend on any binary other than the system shell.
- Outputs "catcat" to the log.

-- 00000000000000000000000000000000-hello.txt --
Hello, World!
-- 00000000000000000000000000000000-hello2-x86_64-linux.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out", "", "r:sha256", "")],
  [],
  ["/opt/zb/store/00000000000000000000000000000000-hello.txt"],
  "x86_64-unknown-linux",
  "/bin/sh",
  ["-c","echo catcat >&2 ; while read line; do echo \"$line\"; done < $in > $out; while read line; do echo \"$line\"; done < $in >> $out"],
  [
    ("in", "/opt/zb/store/00000000000000000000000000000000-hello.txt"),
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
-- 00000000000000000000000000000000-hello2-aarch64-linux.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out", "", "r:sha256", "")],
  [],
  ["/opt/zb/store/00000000000000000000000000000000-hello.txt"],
  "aarch64-unknown-linux",
  "/bin/sh",
  ["-c","echo catcat >&2 ; while read line; do echo \"$line\"; done < $in > $out; while read line; do echo \"$line\"; done < $in >> $out"],
  [
    ("in", "/opt/zb/store/00000000000000000000000000000000-hello.txt"),
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
-- 00000000000000000000000000000000-hello2-aarch64-apple-macos.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out", "", "r:sha256", "")],
  [],
  ["/opt/zb/store/00000000000000000000000000000000-hello.txt"],
  "aarch64-apple-macos",
  "/bin/sh",
  ["-c","echo catcat >&2 ; while read line; do echo \"$line\"; done < $in > $out; while read line; do echo \"$line\"; done < $in >> $out"],
  [
    ("in", "/opt/zb/store/00000000000000000000000000000000-hello.txt"),
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
-- 00000000000000000000000000000000-hello2-x86_64-pc-windows.txt.drv --
Derive(
  [("out", "", "r:sha256", "")],
  [],
  ["/opt/zb/store/00000000000000000000000000000000-hello.txt"],
  "aarch64-pc-windows",
  "C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe",
  [
    "-Command",
    "Write-Output \"catcat\" ; $x = Get-Content -Raw ${env:in} ; ($x + $x) | Out-File -NoNewline -Encoding ascii -FilePath ${env:out}"
  ],
  [
    ("in", "/opt/zb/store/00000000000000000000000000000000-hello.txt"),
    ("out", "/1rz4g4znpzjwh1xymhjpm42vipw92pr73vdgl6xs1hycac8kf2n9")
  ]
)
